title: The Winter Programme
author: Yusuf  A.
desc: Full body 6 days a week one rest day working with >80% of one rep max for compound lifts with lower reps and <80% for isolated lifts with higher reps, when target rep is reached (reps put in trainning programme) move up a weight with half the reps + 1 working up from there to the target reps e.g. bicep curl 10 reps 12.5kg accomplished 5 - 10 reps 15kg until 10 reps achieved then up
